Set foot in the Crystal Dimension.
Step through a portal into the Mining Dimension.
Reach Utopia, where nothing wants to eat you.
Drop in on the Village Dimension.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.get_z: Get your hands on a mob cage.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.kill_: Slay Godzilla. Bring a big sword.
Hunt down and slay the Kraken.
Defeat the Kyuubi, the nine-tailed demon fox.
Defeat The King, the mightiest boss in OreSpawn.
Defeat The Queen and take her scales.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.obtai: Wield Big Bertha, the mightiest blade ever swung.
Claim a Royal Guardian Sword, a blade fit for royalty.
Mine a Ruby, OreSpawn's signature gemstone.
Get your hands on a Tiger's Eye Ingot.
Just plain fun! Ores, dimensions, ultrabosses... and Big Bertha.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.tame_: Win the heart of a Girlfriend or Boyfriend.
book.orespawn_integrations.orespawn_guid: A Field Guide to a More Dangerous World

The ground hums. The trees whisper. Somewhere below y=50, a Kraken is dreaming.$(p)This is your survival manual for everything $(4)OreSpawn$() has dragged into the world: new ores, new dimensions, and far too many things with teeth.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.trink: Wear a keepsake from OreSpawn's monsters in a Charm slot: a boss scale, a Tiger's Eye Ingot, or Kraken Repellent
message.orespawn_integrations.guide_give: An OreSpawn Guide has been tucked into your inventory. Read it before something reads you.
curios.orespawn_integrations.kraken_repe: The Kraken ignores whoever carries this
tooltip.orespawn_integrations.jade.spawn: Erupts moments after being placed. Stand clear!
Only one may awaken per world
tooltip.orespawn_integrations.jade.krake: Vengeful: this Kraken is hunting you!
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.ant_block: A busy mound of friendly Giant Ants. Right-click a Giant Ant and it will tunnel you straight to Utopia; right-click another one there to come home to the Overworld. The mound hatches new ants over time when the sky is clear.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.cage_empt: Throw it at a creature, or simply right-click one, to capture it. Use the filled cage on the ground to release your catch exactly where you want it.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.crystal_t: A termite mound grown over with crystal. Its Termites also tunnel to the Crystal Dimension: right-click one to travel, and right-click another on the far side to return to the Overworld.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.godzilla_: A buried fragment of Mobzilla's ancient egg, found rarely while mining. Gather nine parts and craft them together to restore the complete Ancient Dried Mobzilla Spawn Egg.

An Ancient Dried Mobzilla Spawn Egg, restored from nine egg parts dug out of the deep. Combine it with a Water Bucket in a crafting grid to rehydrate it into a live Mobzilla Spawn Egg. Only one question remains: are you ready?
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.kraken_re: The Kraken cannot stand this stuff. Place it at your harbor and any Kraken within about twenty blocks is steadily pushed away. Comes in a wall-mounted version too.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.rainbow_a: A cheerful mound of Rainbow Ants. Right-click a Rainbow Ant to march off to the Village Dimension; right-click another one there to return to the Overworld.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.ray_gun: Pew pew! Ray Guns cannot be crafted. They are relics of the Robot Labs, so raid a lab's chests to claim one. Repair a worn Ray Gun by combining it with a Block of Redstone in a crafting grid for a full recharge.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.red_ant_b: A mound of Giant Red Ants with a taste for deep places. Right-click a Red Ant to tunnel to the Mining Dimension; right-click another one there to return to the Overworld.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.royal_arm: Royal Guardian armor cannot be crafted. The King keeps the only sets in existence, so defeat him to claim yours.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.royal_gua: The blade of royalty, and it cannot be crafted. Both The King and The Queen carry one, so defeat either to take it.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.termite_b: A towering termite mound. Right-click a Termite to burrow through to the Crystal Dimension; right-click another one there to return to the Overworld.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.the_king_: A buried fragment of The King's ancient egg, found rarely while mining. Gather nine parts and craft them together to restore the complete Ancient Dried The King Spawn Egg.

An Ancient Dried The King Spawn Egg, restored from nine egg parts dug out of the deep. Combine it with a Water Bucket in a crafting grid to rehydrate it into a live spawn egg. The King is the mightiest foe in OreSpawn, so do not wake him lightly.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.the_queen: A buried fragment of The Queen's ancient egg, found rarely while mining. Gather nine parts and craft them together to restore the complete Ancient Dried The Queen Spawn Egg.

An Ancient Dried The Queen Spawn Egg, restored from nine egg parts dug out of the deep. Combine it with a Water Bucket in a crafting grid to rehydrate it into a live spawn egg and summon the Queen herself.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.titanium_: Smelt Titanium Ore in any furnace: 1 ore = 1 nugget, and 9 nuggets make an ingot. A Titanium Ingot also breaks back down into nine nuggets.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.unstable_: A flickering mound of Unstable Ants. Right-click an Unstable Ant to blink out to the Island Dimension, high above an endless sky; right-click another one there to return to the Overworld.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.uranium_n: Smelt Uranium Ore in any furnace: 1 ore = 1 nugget, and 9 nuggets make an ingot. A Uranium Ingot also breaks back down into nine nuggets.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.zoo_cage: Right-click the ground to instantly raise a quartz-and-glass zoo enclosure. The number is the size of the pen. Capture creatures with an Empty Cage, then release them inside to fill out your zoo.
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.zoo_keepe: Give a creature a friendly bop with the Zoo Keeper to make it a permanent resident. It will never despawn, so your zoo stays stocked.
message.orespawn_integrations.shape_abso: You have absorbed the shape of %s!
curios.orespawn_integrations.heart_locke: A loved one within 8 blocks grants Regeneration
Girlfriends will never turn on the wearer
jei.orespawn_integrations.info.heart_loc: Keep your sweetheart close. Worn in a Charm slot, the locket grants steady Regeneration while a Girlfriend or Boyfriend is within 8 blocks, and no Girlfriend will raise a hand against the wearer, not even on Valentine's Day. Craft it from gold, a Ruby and a Poppy; heartbroken Girlfriends very rarely drop one. A keepsake this dear is never lost on death.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.surfa: Mine your very first Ruby. It seeks lava, so watch your step.
Craft any Ruby tool or weapon.
Craft an Extreme Torch. It's a torch, but extreme.
Use the Sifter on water, sand, gravel, dirt or grass. Most rolls are garbage. Some are shoes.
Craft a Hoverboard and hop on. Where you're going, you don't need roads.
Smelt both a Titanium Ingot and a Uranium Ingot.
Craft an Ultimate Sword: one titanium, one uranium, one iron. Suspiciously affordable.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.ant_f: Loot an ant block from an anthill. Yes, the ants ARE doors.
Place an ant block and let it swarm. Right-click an ant empty-handed to hitch a ride.
Let a black ant carry you to Utopia.
Follow a rainbow ant to the Village dimension.
Poke a butterfly bare-handed and get dropped into Chaos. It seemed so gentle.
Visit all six OreSpawn dimensions: Utopia, Mining, Village, Crystal, Islands and Chaos.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.minin: Survive a RED ant's customer service and enter the Mining dimension.
Use a Miner's Dream. Instant mineshaft, some assembly not required.
Assemble the full Ultimate armor set.
Catch a Lava Eel by fishing in lava with the Ultimate Fishing Rod.
Wear a full set of Lava Eel armor. Slippery AND blast-proof.
Storm the Kyuubi Dungeon and put the nine-tailed fox down.
Slay a Basilisk in its maze and claim a Basilisk Scale.
Find the WTF Alien Dungeon and defeat the Alien Boss.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.dunge: Step inside a Haunted House. The mortgage is your soul.
Crack open a dungeon loot chest.
Obtain the Thunder Staff: one diamond, four rubies, infinite drama.
Take the Big Hammer from a Hercules Beetle.
Squeeze Green Goo out of a Triffid. Don't ask what it is.
Kill a large Worm and pull out a Worm Tooth.
Dethrone an Emperor Scorpion for its scale.
Slay a Nightmare (Pitch Black) and keep its scale as a trophy.
Use a Random Dungeon item to summon a dungeon on demand. Delivery fee: your HP.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.menag: Gotta Cage 'Em All
Capture any creature with a Critter Cage.
Zoo Tycoon
Deploy an instant Zoo Cage enclosure.
It's a Match!
Win a Girlfriend over with a poppy. Persistence (and flowers) pays off.
Say It with Swords
Hand your Girlfriend a weapon or armor. She WILL use it.
Player Two Has Entered
Tame a Boyfriend with cooked beef or cooked peacock.
No Saddle, No Problem
Ride one of the great OreSpawn mounts: Dragon, Cephadrome, Leon or Ostrich.
Salad Days
Harvest a tomato, lettuce and a corn cob from OreSpawn crops.
Supreme Achievement
Craft a pizza from tomato, cheese, bacon and bread.
Cheesy Does It
Place your pizza and eat it slice by slice, like a civilized person.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.cryst: The Crystal Method
Ask a termite (politely, empty-handed) to take you to the Crystal dimension.
Bench-marked
Craft a Crystal Workbench from crystal planks.
Where There's Smoke, There's Pink
Build a Crystal Furnace from eight Kyanite (crystal stone).
Pretty in Pink
Smelt a Pink Crystal into a Pink Ingot.
Rose-Tinted Plates
Wear the full Pink armor set. Fabulous AND functional.
Eye of the Tiger
Smelt Tiger's Eye ore into an ingot.
Fairy Odd Weapons
Craft a Fairy Sword, Rat Sword or Skate Bow from the Crystal dimension's... residents.
A Jelly Good Shot
Fletch an Irukandji Arrow: peacock feather, dead jellyfish, crystal stick.
An Apple a Day Keeps the Kraken Away
Eat a Crystal Apple. Regeneration AND Strength, doctor approved.
Beast Mode: Off
Slay a Dungeon Beast in the Crystal deeps.
Cave of Wonders
Loot a Crystal chest.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.tower: Ride an Unstable Ant's teleport to the floating Islands dimension.
Find a Challenge Tower among the islands.
Loot a level-1 Challenge Tower chest.
Loot a level-5 Challenge Tower chest at the very top. Spawn eggs galore.
Recharge a worn-out Ray Gun with a block of redstone.
Set foot in an Ender Castle.
Feed a Cephadrome raw meat, then ride it. Each flight costs one meal. No loyalty program.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.ultra: Krak of Dawn
Release the Kraken. From its mortal coil.
Sea You Later
Slay the Water Dragon in its ocean lair.
Lights Out, Moth
Down Mothra and pocket a Nether Star.
Some Assembly Required
Mine nine Ancient Dried Mobzilla Spawn Egg Parts.
Do NOT Warm the Big Egg
Place a completed Mobzilla spawn egg block. What could possibly hatch?
Down Goes Mobzilla
Defeat Mobzilla, king of the monsters.
Scale Mail, Literally
Forge the full Mobzilla Scale armor set.
Royal Flush: Nine of a Kind
Mine nine Ancient Dried King Spawn Egg Parts. The full egg cannot be found, only made.
Checkmate, Your Majesty
Defeat The King: 7000 HP of pure royalty.
Long Live Nobody
Defeat The Queen and claim her scales, and her son too.
Sword of the Crown
Claim the Royal Guardian Sword from fallen royalty.
Royal Babysitter
Hatch the Queen's egg and let the baby Prince imprint on you.
Monster Mash: Completed It
Defeat every OreSpawn ultraboss: Kraken, Water Dragon, Mothra, Alien Boss, Mobzilla, The King and The Queen.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.chain: Gather all seven Bertha Blade parts: an Ultimate Sword, Kraken Tooth, T-Rex Tooth, Worm Tooth, Caterkiller Jaw, Sea Viper Tongue and a Vortex Eye.
Collect every Bertha Guard component: Basilisk, Emperor Scorpion, Sea Monster, Nightmare, Moth and Jumpy Bug scales, plus one genuine Molenoid Nose.
Gather the five Bertha Handle parts: Ray Gun, Big Hammer, Mantis Claw, Water Dragon Scale and Green Goo. The Ray Gun gets consumed, so craft a spare.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.ultim: Forge the Bertha Blade from seven trophies of the hunt.
Assemble the Bertha Guard from seven legendary scales.
Bind the Bertha Handle. Yes, it eats a whole Ray Gun.
Unite blade, guard and handle into the mightiest sword ever swung.
Slim Big Bertha down into The Slice. Same bite, travel size.
Craft the Battle Axe or the Attitude Adjuster.
Craft the Chainsaw and never look at a forest the same way.
Repair your Big Bertha on a placed strip of duct tape. As the ancients intended.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.chain: Craft the entire Ultimate kit: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, bow and fishing rod.
Follow the corn: grow it, pop it, butter it, salt it, bag it. Movie sold separately.
Craft every Zoo Cage tier from size 2 to size 10. Each one is built from the last.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.f: Tap your Hoverboard with an Ultimate Sword to cycle its paint. Ten colors, zero regrets.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.t: Tape It Till You Make It
Repair a damaged item on placed duct tape.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.s: Gift your Girlfriend an Ultimate Sword. Romance is a two-handed weapon.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.j: Stuff a whole T-Rex into a Critter Cage.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.s: Sift a pair of shoes out of the water. Heels, slippers, you name it. The lake provides.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.l: Collect a Heart from the giant Valentine's Girlfriend. Rose Sword recommended. February 14 only.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.k: Take a hit from the Kyuubi and live to brag about it.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.d: Tame a giant Rubber Ducky with a cod. Squeak responsibly.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.p: Use an Instant Shelter AND an Instant Garden. Home ownership in two clicks.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.r: Plant a Magic Apple. One in a hundred grows a Ginormous Tree, and something lives up there.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.m: Eat a bag of popcorn and a corn dog.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.b: Draw the Ultimate Bow to full power.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.e: Rehydrate an ancient dried spawn egg block with a water bucket.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.d: Visit the graveyard... in the End. Someone had to be buried out there.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.l: Leon Me When You're Not Strong
Tame Leon with raw beef and take to the skies.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.b: Slam your Hoverboard into a wall at full speed. It shatters. You knew it would.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.fun.p: Eat an entire six-slice pizza by yourself.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.landm: Landmark Hunter
Spot any one of OreSpawn's legendary landmarks scattered across the dimensions.
Money Does Grow on Trees
Stand beneath the King's royal ore tree, towering over the plains of Utopia.
Her Royal Tree-ness
Find the Queen's royal ore tree glittering above Utopia's plains.
Altar Ego
Locate the King's summoning altar out in Utopia. Maybe don't push the button just yet.
Queen's Gambit
Locate the Queen's summoning altar in Utopia. Sacrifices sold separately.
Shark Worship
Discover the Cephadrome altar high on the floating Islands. The sand sharks approve.
The Stuff of Nightmares
Stumble into the Nightmare Rookery among the floating Islands. Sleep is optional.
Praying for Loot
Find a Mantis Nest tucked into the Overworld's forests and jungles.
Walk Like an Incan
Uncover the Inca Pyramid rising from the Islands dimension.
Bedside Manor
Check into the Hospital at the edge of The End. The care is out of this world.
Love at First Site
Sail to Girlfriend Island, adrift in the Overworld's oceans.
Isle Be Back
Set foot on Monster Island in the Overworld's oceans. Try to leave the same way.
Here Be Dragons
Dive down to the Water Dragon's lair beneath the Overworld's oceans.
Lost and Petrified
Enter the Basilisk Maze of the Mining Dimension. No staring at the residents.
Shadow of a Doubt
Find the Shadow Dungeon lurking deep beneath the Mining Dimension.
What the Flying Saucer
Dig up the alien dungeon buried under the Mining Dimension. WTF indeed.
Oh, Beehive!
Visit a giant beehive. The big one buzzes in the Mining Dimension; smaller ones hide in Overworld forests.
Spring Break
Bounce into the Bouncy Castle out in the Overworld's deserts.
Fox Hunt
Track down the Kyuubi's dungeon in the Mining Dimension, or an enchanted Overworld grove if you're lucky.
Knight Shift
Find the damsel in distress awaiting rescue in the Village Dimension.
Cartographer of Chaos
Discover every legendary OreSpawn landmark, from Utopia's royal trees to the alien depths of the Mining Dimension.
event.orespawn_integrations.boss_felled: %s has fallen! The world breathes easier.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.moder: Step into the Trial Chambers, where modern wonders await.
Unlock a vault with a Mobzilla Vault Key.
Unlock a vault with a Kraken Vault Key.
Obtain any gear or book bearing the Radioactive enchantment.
Apply the Kraken armor trim to a piece of armor at a smithing table.
Obtain the Kraken Armor Trim Smithing Template.
Witness a meteor come down a little too close for comfort.
travellers_gear.modifier.orespawn_integr: Vest plated with Mobzilla scales: heavy armor and knockback resistance
advancements.orespawn_integrations.big_g: The pack's combat mods finally notice OreSpawn's monsters. Real move-sets for legendary weapons, gear stitched from boss hide, and ore veins that fight back. You win anyway.
Take Big Bertha in hand and try out her new move-set. She sweeps now.
Gather a Traveller's Vest and four Godzilla scales. That's everything Mobzilla Plating requires.
Get your hands on a Mobzilla-Hide, Kraken, or Girlfriend backpack. Carry the boss that once carried the fight to you.
Claim the Emperor's Chitin Band from the Emperor Scorpion. The venom works for you now.
Fell a Weeping Angel. Ten feet of ruby-edged steel doesn't need to blink.
You mined the vein. The vein disagreed. You won anyway.
Spot the shimmer, hear the tick, and defuse a decoy ore mine with wire cutters before it makes its point.
enchantment.orespawn_integrations.radioa: Strikes poison the target. Uranium-based swordsmanship: perfectly safe for the wielder, notably less so for everyone else.
enchantment.orespawn_integrations.kraken: Strikes slow the target, as if seized by tentacles from somewhere deep and unfriendly.
enchantment.orespawn_integrations.dragon: Strikes set the target ablaze. The King does not share his fire cheaply: vault treasure only.
book.orespawn_integrations.library_rumor: Travelers' ledger, kept by the village librarian. A haunted house stands where plains meet taiga. Leaf monsters den beneath the tall grass. Mantis nests hang in the deep jungle. Most who follow this ledger come back. Usually richer.
Day 44. The green ingots do not burn out. The reactor drinks them and asks for more. Haskov bottled the runoff and DRANK it. He spent the night glowing, sprinting, and seeing in the dark. He calls it the Uranium Rush. He is asking for another bottle.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.alive: It Was Always Uranium: The Reactor
Stand inside Incendium's Nether reactor with Danger's fuel in your pocket
advancements.orespawn_integrations.menag: Walking History
Cage a Mammoth. The Ice Age called; it can visit on weekends.
Handle With Care
Cage a Komodo Dragon without becoming a cautionary tale.
Ugliest Catch
Cage a Blobfish. Somebody has to love it.
The Elephant in the Room
Cage an Elephant. Now we can finally talk about it.
High Maintenance
Cage a Giraffe. Order the taller cage. Then the even taller one.
Gonna Need a Bigger Cage
Cage a Great White Shark. From a boat. Please, from a boat.
Chillest Exhibit
Cage a Capybara. It genuinely does not mind.
The Menagerie Grows
Add all seven Naturalist showpieces to your zoo: Mammoth, Komodo Dragon, Blobfish, Elephant, Giraffe, Great White Shark, and Capybara.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.alive: New ruins on the horizon, seasons in the air, and sixteen eyes on the End.
Pull a Miner's Dream out of somebody else's dungeon.
Obtain any End Remastered eye. Only fifteen to go.
Witness the Prince take wing as the season turns.
Obtain Kraken Repellent. The deckhands nail it to the mast for a reason.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.big_g: Your Guard Dog stood at your side as a Royal boss fell. Who's a good boy? Certified.
item.endrem.royal_eye.description: §7§oOnly the Royal Court's treasure vaults remember the way to the End
event.orespawn_integrations.honorary_cou: The Royal Court salutes the fall of %s, honorary nobility of the Nether!
event.orespawn_integrations.tombstone_ha: A chill drifts up from the tombstone...
event.orespawn_integrations.mummys_curse: Something stirs beneath the pharaoh's tomb...
orespawn_integrations.familiar_desc.girl: A pocket-sized devoted companion. While she is summoned, any living attacker that hurts her player is struck with Weakness II for 5 seconds. Jealousy is a powerful motivator. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a wild Girlfriend; a tamed girlfriend is never taken by the ritual.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.her_s: There is more to her than poppies and thrown shoes. Court her properly and find out.
Bring your girlfriend a real gift: a rose, a sweet, a teddy bear. Not a poppy. She's SEEN poppies.
Three thoughtful gifts in. She wrote you into the diary, and Volume II is yours.
Six gifts. Even the Boyfriend approves now. Volume III comes with a secret on the last page.
Eight milestones, one rose-gold ring, one answer. You already know what it says.
Pull the pink one out of a dungeon chest: the Tome of the Girlfriend. Cast it and think of her.
Bound as a familiar, she follows you anywhere, portals included.
message.orespawn_integrations.date_night: %s loves it! She feels a little stronger.
%s hugs the gift tight. Something about her seems tougher now.
%s beams at you. She won't forget this.
%s already treasures one of those. Try something new.
%s eyes the ring... not yet. Court her properly first: eight milestones, then ask.
%s taps her ring finger. She's already spoken for, by you.
item.orespawn_integrations.dirty_arc_rea: Palladium nearly killed Tony. This is fine.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.urani: The pack's power mods discover what Danger buried. The geiger sings, the cauldron glows, the warthog eats, and nobody gets hurt. That's the whole point.
Carry a geiger counter near a buried OreSpawn vein and hear it sing. Check your dose after. Still zero. It sings; it never bites.
Get your hands on a Dirty Arc Reactor. Palladium nearly killed Tony. Uranium? This is fine.
Drink Bottled Uranium straight from a glowing cauldron. Glowing skin, night eyes, quick feet. Haskov asked for another bottle.
Pocket a Block of Uranium for the enchanting room. Shelved, it reads nearly pure Quanta. The table gets volatile, and you get options.
Feed a GAU-8 a belt of uranium ingots. Danger's or the other guy's? The warthog doesn't check the label.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.royal: Every royal drop is currency now. Scrolls, scales, shards, and one very good egg. The boss economy is open for business.
Take a spell scroll off one of the Court's bosses. Each royal teaches exactly one school. Collect the curriculum.
Press eight queen scales around an egg. Whatever is in there, it's family now.
Incubate the Royal Dragon Egg until the Prince hatches and imprints on the first face he sees. Yours, ideally.
Claim a soul shard pre-bound to a royal boss. Tier one comes as a gift; the next thousand kills are on you.
Trade queen scales to the Bee Queen for royal jelly. Two monarchies, one table, nobody stung.
Uncraft royal gear at the Uncrafting Table and walk away with six queen scales. The Court always buys back.
Temper the Royal Guardian Sword with witherite at the Mechanical Fusion Anvil. The Harbinger paid for the metal; your enchantments survive the forge.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.world: Rites call the kings by name, industry rolls the metals, and the statues never forget. The rest of the pack finally admits OreSpawn happened.
Chalk the circle, lay out the scales, and wait for a real thunderstorm. Gojira does not answer clear skies.
Finish the full catalyst grind and raise a statue of Mobzilla. The boss finally holds still.
The Philosopher's Stone has learned some local geology: stone, soil, and timber can all wear Crystal Dimension colors now. Redecorate responsibly. Or don't.
Roll OreSpawn titanium into reinforced rail. Industry has acknowledged the ores. The ores are flattered.
Craft an aircraft with your own two hands. The recipes were in the files all along. Somebody finally plugged them in.
compat.orespawn_integrations.rite.needs_: The deep answers only over open ocean. Your offerings are returned.
compat.orespawn_integrations.rite.wrong_: The circle refuses this place. Your offerings are returned.
origins.orespawn_integrations.antling.de: One of the ants that run OreSpawn's dimension gates: small, tireless, and never alone.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_swar: Calls up to 3 red ants to fight beside you for 90 seconds. Costs 6 hunger; 30-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_tunn: Phase through up to 3 blocks of wall. 8-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_smal: Two-thirds player size with full reach.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_colo: OreSpawn ants, termites and ant robots never attack you.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_swee: Sugar, honey, cookies, popcorn, corn and berries restore double hunger.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_ligh: Cannot wear heavy chestplates or leggings (iron and above, OreSpawn gem armour).
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_prey: Spiders and scorpions hunt you from 24 blocks.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_form: Look like an ant while the form toggle is on (visual only).
Keybind: switch the ant look on or off.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_asce: Swarm Call now summons ant robots.
power.orespawn_integrations.antling_apex: Six ant robots, two per call, 20-second cooldown.
origins.orespawn_integrations.kraken_spa: Raised by the sea's monster. The ocean is home; the shore is a slow death.
power.orespawn_integrations.kraken_spawn: Fills while you are in water.
A 4-block cloud that blinds and slows everything inside for 6 seconds. 12-second cooldown.
Drags every mob within 12 blocks toward you, then a crushing wave for 6 damage. Costs 30 Tide; 15-second cooldown.
Guardians, drowned, squid and OreSpawn's sea monsters, the Kraken included, ignore you.
Only fish, kelp and crab feed you.
Loses air on land; about 45 seconds before it hurts.
1 damage per second in direct sun while dry.
Air lasts twice as long on land.
Undertow also heals you for each mob it catches.
Once every 15 minutes the Kraken itself fights beside you for 2 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.royal_bloo: A distant cousin of the King and Queen. The court knows your face; so does everyone who hates the court.
power.orespawn_integrations.royal_blood_: Hostiles within 10 blocks get Weakness II and Slowness for 8 seconds while you get Strength. 45-second cooldown.
The King, the Queen, the Princes, the Princess and Mobzilla will not attack you.
Villagers refresh their trades for you.
Starts with one Queen's Scale, proof of lineage.
Enemies of the court and common hostiles hunt you from 32 blocks.
The Prince answers as a bodyguard for 3 minutes, once every 20 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.uranium_bo: Born in the glow of an OreSpawn uranium vein. You run hot.
power.orespawn_integrations.uranium_born: A 4-power blast that breaks no blocks. Sets you alight for 2 seconds, then Fire Resistance for 10. Costs 60 Heat; 40-second cooldown.
Whoever hits you gets Poison II for 5 seconds.
Explosions do double damage to you.
Animals and villagers flee from you.
Attackers get Wither instead of Poison.
A child of Mothra. Light is life; fire is the end of it.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_du: A 3-block cloud that blinds and lifts everything inside for 3 seconds. 10-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_fl: A strong upward hop that chains into a glide. 6-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_dr: Speed and Regeneration near bright light.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_ne: Fruit, berries, honey and mushrooms restore double.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_fi: Fire and lava do triple damage.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_li: Cannot wear heavy armour (moth scale and leather are fine).
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_ev: Moth Dust also heals whoever stands in it (allies too).
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_as: True flight while in bright light.
power.orespawn_integrations.luna_moth_ap: Once every 20 minutes Mothra fights beside you for 2 minutes.
Mothra and the moths ignore you.
origins.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi.des: A fox spirit wearing a player's skin. Fire, mischief, and never being where the sword lands.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_foxfi: Regenerates out of combat while dry.
Casts Iron's Spellbooks Firebolt at level 3, no book needed. Costs 20 Fox-fire; 6-second cooldown; not while wet.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_nine_: Teleport to where you look, 24 blocks. 12-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_trade: Swap places with the mob you look at. 25-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_kin.d: Cats, foxes and the Kyuubi ignore you.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_hound: Wolves, caramel mutts and cliff racers hunt you.
Look like a Kyuubi while the form toggle is on (visual only).
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_form_: Keybind: switch the fox look on or off.
power.orespawn_integrations.kyuubi_apex_: Two Kyuubi fight beside you for a minute, every 5 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.fairy.name: Fairy
origins.orespawn_integrations.fairy.desc: A fairy from Utopia, half a block tall, healing everything around it, and terrified of iron.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_blessi: Regeneration II and Absorption for everyone within 8 blocks (you included). Costs 40 Sparkle; 20-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_green_: Crops grow while you stand near them.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_mist.d: Heals nearby players a heart every 8 seconds.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_gentle: Fairies and bees treat you as kin.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_cold_i: Iron weapons do 50% more damage to you.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_ascend: Blessing also cures poison and wither.
power.orespawn_integrations.fairy_apex_s: Once every 15 minutes a killing blow leaves you at one heart in a sparkle cloud that heals everyone near you.
origins.orespawn_integrations.gamma_metr: The energy parasite from the OreSpawn caves. Everything you touch feeds you; cold is the only thing that kills you.
power.orespawn_integrations.gamma_metroi: Pulls the nearest mob to you, withers it for 4 seconds and heals you two hearts. 15-second cooldown.
Mobs within 3 blocks slowly lose health to you.
1 damage per second in snowy or frozen biomes.
Villagers and animals flee from you.
Latch also grants 4 seconds of Resistance.
Once every 20 minutes you survive a killing blow at two hearts.
origins.orespawn_integrations.raptor.des: A Velocity Raptor with a crafting table. Speed, pounce, pack.
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_pounc: A dash that deals 5 damage plus half your weapon damage to anything in its path. 5-second cooldown.
Strength II and Speed for you and every creature within 12 blocks for 15 seconds (point your pets first). 30-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_comma: Your tamed animals attack the mob you look at.
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_pack_: Your tamed animals get +3 hearts and speed.
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_no_ra: Cannot use bows, crossbows, tridents or OreSpawn guns.
Look like a raptor while the form toggle is on (visual only).
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_form_: Keybind: switch the raptor look on or off.
power.orespawn_integrations.raptor_apex_: Three raptors hunt with you for 2 minutes, every 10 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.beaver.des: The cosy one. Trees fall, dams rise, nothing is in a hurry.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_plank: Places an oak plank where you look, 6 blocks away, every 1.5 seconds. Bridges, dams, stairs.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_timbe: Breaking a log fells the whole tree.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_wood_: Eats logs, sticks, saplings and bamboo.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_sawmi: Oak logs give 6 planks instead of 4.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_teeth: Bare hands chop like a stone axe.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_waddl: Sprinting drains hunger twice as fast.
power.orespawn_integrations.beaver_apex_: Planks every half second, 8 blocks away.
origins.orespawn_integrations.saci.name: Saci
origins.orespawn_integrations.saci.descr: The one-legged trickster with the red cap. You are never where they look.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_redemoi: Spins up a whirlwind that lifts and tumbles mobs for 5 seconds while you hop forward out of it. Costs 40 Mischief; 25-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_cachimb: A smoke cloud that blinds and confuses for 5 seconds. 10-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_furto.d: Steals the held item of mobs within 5 blocks. 40-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_kin.des: Both Sacis in the pack ignore you.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_one_leg: Walks 20% slower; hopping is the way to travel.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_form.de: Look like the Saci while the form toggle is on (visual only).
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_form_to: Keybind: switch the Saci look on or off.
power.orespawn_integrations.saci_apex_tw: A second Saci joins your mischief for a minute, every 5 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari: The one-eyed giant sloth of the Amazon. Slow, enormous, unstoppable.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_t: A ground slam for 9 damage in 6 blocks with heavy knockback. 12-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_r: Weakens and staggers every mob within 12 blocks. 30-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_c: Bare hands work like a diamond axe.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_d: Only meat, mushrooms and honey feed you.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_n: Cannot use bows, crossbows, tridents or OreSpawn guns.
power.orespawn_integrations.mapinguari_a: The roar also roots enemies for 4 seconds.
Regenerates a heart every 3 seconds out of combat.
origins.orespawn_integrations.capivara.d: Everyone's friend. The pack's chill mode.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_ban: Regeneration II for 8 seconds for you and everyone within 4 blocks, only while in water. 20-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_tra: Nothing attacks you unless you attack first.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_gra: Plants, fruit, mango, corn and strawberries restore double.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_sit: Slow falling while sneaking in the air. Style.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_no_: Sprinting drains hunger triple; capybaras do not run.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_for: Look like a capybara while the form toggle is on (visual only).
Keybind: switch the capybara look on or off.
power.orespawn_integrations.capivara_ape: Two capybaras keep you company and soak up attention, every 5 minutes.
By day a person, by night the wolf. The moon decides how much wolf.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_ui: Speed II for 10 seconds, night only. 45-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_pa: Two wolves answer for 90 seconds, night only.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_sa: A pounce for 6 damage, night only. 8-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_fu: Under a full moon: Strength II and Speed on top of everything.
Under a full moon you look like the Lobisomem (visual).
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_ki: Wolves, caramel mutts and the Lobisomem ignore you.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_ni: At night only meat feeds you.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_hu: Iron golems and village guards attack you on sight at night.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_ev: The day form loses its attack penalty.
power.orespawn_integrations.lobisomem_ap: Apex: Every Night a Full Moon
origins.orespawn_integrations.cuca.name: Cuca
origins.orespawn_integrations.cuca.descr: The crocodile witch. Brews, minions, and a swamp that answers to you.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_feitico: Hurls a potion and poisons and slows every mob within 3 blocks of you. Costs 15 Witchcraft; 6-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_louca.d: Summons three Cuclins for 2 minutes. Costs 40 Witchcraft; 30-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_caldeir: A 5-block cloud for 15 seconds: players inside regenerate, everything else weakens. 60-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_kin.des: The Cuca, her Cuclins and the possessed tableware ignore you.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_sun_wea: Weakness and Slowness in direct sunlight.
power.orespawn_integrations.cuca_apex_cu: Every 15 minutes the Cuca herself fights beside you for 2 minutes.
origins.orespawn_integrations.curupira.d: The guardian of the forest with backward feet. Hunters get lost; the woods heal.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_cha: Every creature within 16 blocks is rooted in place for 6 seconds. 40-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_rai: Casts Iron's Spellbooks Root at level 2. 12-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_for: Speed and Regeneration in forests, jungles and swamps.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_gre: Saplings and crops grow fast around you in the woods.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_wil: Wolves, foxes, ocelots, birds and the forest animals never attack you.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_for: Fruit, berries and mushrooms restore double.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_out: Slowness outside forests, jungles and swamps.
Hunger burns 50% faster outside the woods.
power.orespawn_integrations.curupira_ape: Once every 20 minutes the forest refuses to let you die.
origins.orespawn_integrations.mula.name: Mula sem Cabeça
origins.orespawn_integrations.mula.descr: The cursed woman turned fire mule, fastest thing on four hooves after dark.
Speed IV for 8 seconds, night only. 15-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.mula_relinch: Casts Iron's Spellbooks Fire Breath at level 2. 30-second cooldown.
Animals and villagers flee at night.
power.orespawn_integrations.mula_quenche: Water and rain hurt at night.
power.orespawn_integrations.mula_apex_fl: At night, once every 20 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at two hearts in a burst of flame.
Two hearts, a long life, and one more regeneration than everyone else.
power.orespawn_integrations.time_lord_re: Once every 15 minutes a killing blow instead leaves you at four hearts in a golden burst. You are Weak for a minute, land a few blocks away and drop what you were holding.
Return to your bed or spawn. 90-second cooldown.
power.orespawn_integrations.time_lord_st: Immune to Nausea, Darkness and Slowness.
power.orespawn_integrations.time_lord_ap: The burst also fully heals players within 6 blocks.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.sealed_scrap: A Ledger Scrap was inside. Somebody filed it under "luck".
orespawn_integrations.lucky.anvil: An anvil fell out of the sky. It's yours now.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.lava: The casket was hot inside. Grab a bucket.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.chicken_towe: A tower of chickens. Is this a trap?
orespawn_integrations.lucky.whole_egg_we: One whole King a week. Here's a ninth.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.grace: The Hoard goes easy on hatchlings. For now.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.sender.inner: the King of the Inner Sea
effect_holder.orespawn_integrations.gran: The Great Refusal: the Wither Army
orespawn_integrations.loaner.name: Big Bertha (Loaner)
orespawn_integrations.loaner.tooltip: On loan from the Treasury. %s swings left.
orespawn_integrations.loaner.refit: A loaner doesn't get refitted. Return it as you got it.
orespawn_integrations.loaner.rolled: The Treasury lends you a Big Bertha. Count your swings.
orespawn_integrations.royal_seal.stage_s: A King's egg on a stage is for Squires and up. Train first.
orespawn_integrations.royal_seal.refused: This egg is royal. It hatches for Knights, or on a proper stage.
orespawn_integrations.royal_seal.spawner: Royal eggs don't go in cages.
orespawn_integrations.royal_seal.tooltip: Royal seal. Hatches for a Knight, or on a proper stage.
Royal seal. Hatches for a Knight. No stage will do.
orespawn_integrations.mobzilla.cage: The cage is for beasts, not bosses.
orespawn_integrations.duplicates.boss_re: A boss is not duplicated. Denied.
orespawn_integrations.lucky.test.load_or: Load order: %s of 40 casket rolls came out 10-12. Zero means ly's own root won.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.causo: Open your first commissioned tale; the Land tells it bigger.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.gambi: Got yourself a hive; now throw a pearl at it and the Queen's sister will answer.
Four dust make a block, and the dust is usually a witch's; the clouds take it for a frame.
Take your first Monday bounty: place, target, price.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.livro: Punch a coin out of the sky's loose change.
Why is nothing where it belongs?
A Hatchling, logged as eggs, assorted, 1 lot.
One day ahead, with the Royal Clock: every come-back-tomorrow is his address.
Asleep in their royal trees since the Spill.
Where are the King and Queen?
Utopia's treasury cracked, and the Hoard is still falling.
Why do things fall from the sky?
The Unrecorded climb the moth roads from the oubliette.
Why are the nights full of horrors?
advancements.orespawn_integrations.paris: Sleep in a bed that will have you back.
Home Is Where the Bed Is
advancements.orespawn_integrations.prope: Crash the Treasury's Hoverboard into anything.
Sign out your first piece of Treasury property; it is still theirs.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.secre: Find something the Land never told anyone.
Wake to your first day name; the Land keeps a schedule.
advancements.orespawn_integrations.wonde: Filed under 'tree': finders keepers, and it found you.
Shake hands with an ant and wake up in the King's mines.
A royal dragon dropped a letter at your feet, and it knew what you were.
The whole village hid from you because you were an egg, and the midwife put your twin on your birth form.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.open: Raise the spyglass. Hold it on anything far away. The Treasury will take it from there.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p01.name: A village
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p01.text: Villagers, a bell and a well. Most villages keep a Registry desk somewhere, if you can find the clerk.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p02.name: A Pandora henge
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p02.text: Standing stones around a box nobody ordered. Opened, the Queen's mail answers. Not advised before dinner.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p03.name: A Pandora shrine
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p03.text: A smaller altar to the same box. Same contents, less ceremony. No signature required.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p04.name: A Pretender's tower
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p04.text: A tower some claimant built to look royal. The deed is not on file. The loot, regrettably, is real.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p05.name: A Hoard nest
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p05.text: A treetop stuffed with fallen Hoard. Climb at your own risk; the Treasury takes no claims for falls.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p06.name: A sky nest
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p06.text: The same nest on a higher shelf. Sighted from below, filed from below.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p07.name: A tavern
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p07.text: Food, drink, a bed and gossip. It is not a boteco. Do not say so inside.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p08.name: A firewatch tower
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p08.text: A tall wooden post for watching smoke. From the top, more sightings. Efficient.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p09.name: A watchtower
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p09.text: Wizards, engineers or outposts, all of them tall. Filed together to save paper.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p10.name: The lighthouse
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p10.text: One light on the coast, kept by nobody in particular. The ships are not on file either.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p11.name: A Hunter tent
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p11.text: Hunters camp here between bounties. Knock first; they are armed.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p12.name: A Collectors' post
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p12.text: The Collectors' outpost: tax for nobody, collected anyway. Keep your receipts.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p13.name: An Unrecorded tower
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p13.text: Dark stone and no record at all. What lives here was never registered. Sight it from far.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p14.name: The Cuca's hut
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p14.text: A cottage in the swamp that smells of syrup. The owner wants a royal egg. Do not bring one.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p15.name: The Lost Cathedral
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p15.text: A church nobody built, on no map. Bells at the wrong hours. File it and walk on.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p16.name: An OreSpawn oddity
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p16.text: A haunted house, a duck pond, a bouncy castle: the Hoard's odd furniture, left out in the rain. One family.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p17.name: Girlfriend Island
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p17.text: An island with a resident who writes letters. Visiting hours not posted.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p18.name: The Mobzilla Arena
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p18.text: The Royal Executioner's yard. He is usually asleep. Keep it that way.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p19.name: The Umvuthana grove
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p19.text: Masked folk around a bird-faced chief. They trade, for the right fee.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p20.name: The mountain tower
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p20.text: A wizard's tower up a peak. The climb is the fee.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p21.name: A Hydra outpost
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p21.text: People in green uniforms guarding crates. Not on our payroll. Sign nothing.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p22.name: The bandit towers
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p22.text: Bandits on stilts. They collect too, without a receipt.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p23.name: Ruins
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p23.text: The old walls of nobody's house. A good place to find what fell.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p24.name: The boteco
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p24.text: Seu Zé's bar. Credit tomorrow, stories today.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p25.name: The Hunt Lodge
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p25.text: Captain Iracema's lodge and the Monday board. Place, target, price.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p26.name: The Hatching Ground
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p26.text: Shelf 9, where your lot was filed. First stamp, free of charge.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p27.name: The Prince
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p27.text: A young royal dragon on his rounds. He writes. Write back.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p28.name: The Girlfriend
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p28.text: The Girlfriend, on her side of the story. Be polite.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p29.name: The Mestre
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p29.text: An old man who gives things away. The Treasury has questions.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p30.name: A Saci Pererê
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p30.text: One leg, a red cap and a whirlwind. Count your spoons.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p31.name: A Court Beast
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p31.text: A beast of the old court: scorpion, basilisk, alien or caterpillar. From far. Only from far.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p32.name: The Mapinguari
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p32.text: A forest giant with one eye and a mouth in its belly. Sundays are his. Stay home.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p33.name: Caramelo
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p33.text: The realm's caramel dog. The best citizen on file.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p34.name: A sky beast
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p34.text: Something big up there: shark, bird or cab. Look up, then file.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p35.name: Mobzilla
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p35.text: The Royal Executioner, out of his yard. Note the time. Leave.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p36.name: The Kraken
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p36.text: The Admiral of the sea. She remembers every squid. Keep to the shore.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p37.name: The door cloud
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p37.text: Three butterflies together at dusk: the door down. Too early for you.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p38.name: A Hoard Fall
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p38.text: Something gold coming down, whistling. Not a star. Mark where it lands.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p39.name: The mãe-da-lua
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p39.text: A bird that looks like a branch, crying at dusk. The night starts when she does.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p40.name: The Mula's fire trail
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p40.text: Fire across a field on a Thursday, and no animal in sight. File it from a distance.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p41.name: Red islands over the void
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p41.text: Red islands over the void, seen from the ledge. You're early. They will wait.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p52.name: The Prince on his flyover, from above
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p52.text: The Prince, seen from higher than the Prince. He noticed.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p53.name: The King's tree from 64 blocks
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p53.text: The King's tree in Utopia, from sixty-four blocks. He is asleep inside. Do not knock.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p54.name: The cloud gap
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p54.text: The overworld through a gap in the Aether's clouds. Everything you own, very small.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p55.name: The Revoada leaving the Mines
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p55.text: Leonopteryx leaving the Mines in a flock. Count them; nobody else does.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p56.name: A dinosaur
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p56.text: A dinosaur, alive despite the records. Sighted at a distance, as advised.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p57.name: A Host robot
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p57.text: A robot of the Host, still on its rounds. Its paperwork expired long ago.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p58.name: A sea beast
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p58.text: Something large under the water. Whale or worse. The sea keeps its own file.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p59.name: The Capelobo's Stare (night)
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p59.text: Two eyes in the dark, at night only. The Capelobo is looking back. Do not wave.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p60.name: A capivara crossing water
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p60.text: A capybara crossing water, exactly where it belongs.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p61.name: The Lobisomem
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p61.text: A wolf that walks on two legs on Fridays. Paperwork pending.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p62.name: A Mutant
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p62.text: Something ordinary, much too big. The form has no box for it.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p63.name: An Unrecorded lord
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p63.text: A lord of the Unrecorded, never written down. Now it is, by you.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p64.name: Big game
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p64.text: Elephant, giraffe, rhino or hippo. The Land's own, and big about it.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p65.name: A Dusk Court lord
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p65.text: A lord of the Dusk Court: the naga, the lich or the hydra. Bow from a distance.
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p66.name: A Hatchery beast
orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p66.text: A whale in the clouds or a bird that walks. Hatched upstairs, filed downstairs.

orespawn_integrations.caderneta.p67.text: A bee the size of a cart, in the Queen's sister's halls. Friendly. Mostly.

orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.arca: A casket, stuck in the canopy since the night it rained junk.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.chap: A hat fell out of the tree, straight into your Wardrobe. It wasn't yours. It is now.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.gave: That doesn't grow on trees. It isn't even from this world.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.part: A piece of King fell out. About a ninth.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.pres: The Queen's mail, caught on a branch. Refused, of course.
orespawn_integrations.extravio.copa.reta: A scrap of the Ledger, tangled in the leaves.
orespawn_integrations.gemeo.lore.1: Eggs, assorted, 1 lot. Misfiled: entered as a 'tree'.
orespawn_integrations.gemeo.lore.2: Set it down and tap it. Then tap it again.
orespawn_integrations.guia.cover: New pages are stapled in as needed. The management.$(br2)The guide says what it is. The notebook says where you saw it.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p1.foot: Lost? Find the smoke, or climb the highest thing you can see.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p1.name: What is all this
orespawn_integrations.guia.p1.text: The Ledger is torn: nothing is where it was filed. Here, eggs grow on trees, animals wear other people's hats and boxes fall from the sky. This guide says what each thing is, and whose.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p2.foot: An egg in the stone? Add water: a bucket and a dried egg on the bench make the spawn egg. Three of your siblings are in the Nest's straw.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p2.name: Your batch
orespawn_integrations.guia.p2.text.1: Eggs, assorted, 1 lot: you weren't the only egg on Shelf 9. The rest of the batch fell wherever the tear filed it: in the Nest's straw, in the stone, in the trees.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p2.text.2: A batch egg that hatches and follows you is family. Crouch and tap it to pocket it; safer at night. If it dies it turns back into an egg, with a chick for change. Chicks tame with Guaraná.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p3.name: The Wardrobe
orespawn_integrations.guia.p3.text.1: The Spill night began as a masked ball. The Royal Wardrobe burst, and to this day one creature in three wears a hat that isn't theirs.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p3.text.2: Field Correction: touch the creature with a Ledger Scrap in hand and the hat goes back to the Wardrobe, which is now you. Open your Wardrobe to wear it.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p3.text.3: Works on cows, zombies, anything you dare. The rest of what's out of place, two uraniums, two titaniums, a bench corrects with a scrap.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.margin.squ: Now the butterfly takes you to real Chaos. Tier 7. Sneak-use it for your old ledge.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.margins: No coal? Fireflies come off in your hand.$(br2)Don't put it on an Eye of Ender block. Seriously.$(br2)And hide it from the Aliens: they eat them.$(br2)A parrot doing a creeper? Could be a creeper. Could be the parrot. When in doubt, run.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.name: Doors
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.text.1: Doors. An ant, empty hand: the provinces. A butterfly: the pit (too early, go home). A diamond in a flower-ringed pond: the Dusk Court.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.text.2: A glowstone frame and a bucket of water: the clouds; the crate's four are a start, and witches leave the dust, four dust a block.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p4.text.3: An ender pearl thrown at a beehive or a bee nest: the Queen's sister answers. A hive takes six oak planks and three honeycombs. Obsidian and fire: the Furnace.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p5.name: The Hoard's furniture
orespawn_integrations.guia.p5.text.1: The Hoard spilled the furniture of ninety-four worlds, and nobody assembled it. A chisel (iron and a stick): any stone in another pattern, for free. The framing saw: any shape, wearing any block's face.
orespawn_integrations.guia.p5.text.2: The DecoBench (three planks, five logs, one iron): three thousand ornaments, paid in dye. Bibliocraft and Refurbished: shelves, tables, a stove that really cooks. A Parish Stone by the door, and the Land moves in nearby.
orespawn_integrations.guia.title: The Hoard Field Guide

orespawn_integrations.princes_letter.pag: To whatever hatched: the throne is empty. The court is open to applicants. Bring snacks. Sincerely, the Prince.
Don't tell the Admiral I wrote.
Mother said your lot were here before us. True?
Do you talk to plants? Mother wants to know.
Beast or machine? Doesn't matter, write back.
Have you died? What's it like? Serious question.
Teach me a spell? A small one.
You hit bosses barehanded? Take me along.
What are you again? Answer overleaf.
orespawn_integrations.princes_letter.hin: Ask the ants. They know the roads.
orespawn_integrations.princes_letter.pps: If something falls near you, it's yours. Finders keepers, as your little egg will tell you. (The Treasury says otherwise. The Treasury is closed.)
orespawn_integrations.princes_letter.pag: FORM 7-B. Application for the Regency. Requirements: (1) one Crown, any condition; (2) the Ledger's Spine; (3) one Queen Scale (taken by force or found by luck); (4) the votes of twelve Electors. Deliver in person at any Royal Altar. Processing time: one (1) boss, or none, if Her Majesty approves of the candidate. Do not fold. The paper crown is a separate item.
orespawn_integrations.first_fall.warning: Something gold is falling. It isn't a star. Stars don't whistle.
orespawn_integrations.first_fall.consign: This crate has a consignee. It isn't you.
orespawn_integrations.first_fall.item5_s: ITEM 5: 1 small egg, misfiled. It was meant to be in a tree.
orespawn_integrations.first_fall.item6_n: ITEM 6: one notice. The recipes have been put back. Nothing else has.

Deceased applicant: present a death certificate.

orespawn_integrations.odete_campo.casket: Scrap sitting in your pocket? Eight planks and it's a casket, sized to your rank.
orespawn_integrations.odete_campo.notebo: Anything you spot from far off, write it down. The Treasury lost the map with everything else.
orespawn_integrations.odete_campo.leavin: The Registry desk is that way. Take a number: priority is today.

orespawn_integrations.correction.jei.row: Another world's uranium, entered as the King's. The weight a furnace gives. The crusher gives more.
Old man's beard is the Hoard's, sweetie. With Treasury paper it's auntie's moss.
The Hoard eats the Land's crab and calls it the King's. Sign here.
Double entry: two swords on one form. The Land allows a swap; we reverse the other.
It comes out new: enchantments don't come along.
Another world's titanium, entered as the King's. In nuggets: the King signs for no bars.
